notes.title: Game Release version 1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for your patience during the wait. We're excited to announce that the missing part of the game has now been released. Please note that the arcade feature has been temporarily removed as it's still under development.

We truly appreciate your continued support and understanding.

— sodaAnimation

notes.title: Update 1 - Quick Fixes
notes.notes:
We're happy to announce that we have fixed the issue where players would get stuck on the football field. You can now enjoy uninterrupted gameplay!

[b]
Upcoming[/b]
Unfortunately, Steam has rejected the release of our H-content, but we're working on releasing it separately. Stay tuned for updates on this.

Known errors

-Game is crashing when playing battles
-Some users cant click on buttons.
